title: Draft Comprehensive README.md Structure
description: Outline and draft the structure for a new, comprehensive README.md file for the 'everything-app-starter' repository.
details: Create a logical structure for the README.md including the following sections: Project Overview, Key Features, Technology Stack, Getting Started (Prerequisites, Installation, Environment Setup), Project Structure, Available Scripts, Deployment Instructions, and Additional Resources. Include placeholders for badges (e.g., license, build status) at the top. Reference the PRD and repository analysis to ensure all relevant topics are covered.
test_strategy: Review the outline for completeness and logical flow. Ensure all major aspects of the project are represented and that the structure is easy to follow for new contributors.

title: Populate README.md with Accurate Content
description: Fill in each section of the README.md with clear, concise, and accurate information based on the PRD, codebase, and best practices.
details: Populate the drafted structure with detailed content: summarize the project, list features, describe the tech stack, provide step-by-step setup and installation instructions, document all required environment variables, explain the project structure, and detail deployment steps (including Docker and Vercel). Add shields.io badges for license and build status. Include links to official documentation for major technologies used. If a .env.example file does not exist, create one as a companion to the README.
test_strategy: Proofread for clarity, accuracy, and completeness. Cross-check instructions by referencing the codebase and package.json. Validate that all environment variables and scripts are documented.

title: Review and Validate README.md Instructions
description: Test the accuracy and usability of the new README.md by following its instructions on a clean environment.
details: Simulate a new developer onboarding experience: follow the 'Getting Started' and 'Deployment' instructions from scratch, using a fresh clone of the repository. Verify that all steps work as described, including environment setup, installation, running the app, and deploying via Docker. Note any missing or unclear steps and update the README.md as needed.
test_strategy: Perform a full setup and deployment using only the README.md as a guide. Address any issues or ambiguities encountered. Optionally, have another team member repeat the process for further validation.
